declarations.name: DkMath.Algebra.BinomTail.add_pow_tail_exists
declarations.statement:
lemma add_pow_tail_exists [CommSemiring α] (a b : α) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∃ H : α, (a + b) ^ n = b ^ n + (n : α) * b ^ (n - 1) * a + a ^ 2 * H
declarations.elaborated_check:
DkMath.Algebra.BinomTail.add_pow_tail_exists.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [CommSemiring α] (a b : α) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
  ∃ H, (a + b) ^ n = b ^ n + ↑n * b ^ (n - 1) * a + a ^ 2 * H

declarations.name: DkMath.Algebra.BinomTail.binom_tail_nat_dvd
declarations.statement:
lemma binom_tail_nat_dvd (u y : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    u ^ 2 ∣ ((u + y) ^ n - y ^ n - n * y ^ (n - 1) * u)
declarations.elaborated_check:
DkMath.Algebra.BinomTail.binom_tail_nat_dvd (u y : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
  u ^ 2 ∣ (u + y) ^ n - y ^ n - n * y ^ (n - 1) * u

lemma add_pow_gt_sum_pows_nat (a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (k : ℕ) :
